result.analyst_notes: Factual and corporate, opening with scale claims ($18 billion revenue, 55,000 employees) before values. Customers are the framing stakeholder; the mission is stated absolutely ('Our mission is to') with no hedging. Mixes 'we' and 'Our' voice with third-person company description. Aspirational wording is limited to the mission line; the rest reads as product and brand listing. Workforce, DEI and integrity are absent.
